item.title: MiBeeNvr v0.10.1 → v0.11.0: fnOS Install Fixes + GB/T 28181 Support + Full-Day Playback Timeline
item.description: A few days after v0.10.0 went stable, fnOS users’ feedback boiled down to one sentence: it won’t install. It took seven rounds of installs on a live RK3582 fnOS box, plus SSH-ing into containers to read logs, to dig the three blockers out one by one. The previous release post here was still on v0.10.0-preview.1; that’s three versions unaccounted for — stable, patch, and now v0.11.0 — so this post covers them together.
